paragraphs.text: Custom brand icon and name for the DeepSeek Harness Web client, editable live from a settings card
# dsh-plugin-brand-custom
Custom brand icon and name for the DeepSeek Harness Web client — replaces the sidebar brand mark/nam
e and the conversation hero mark, with a settings card to change them live, no rebuild and no reload
and the conversation hero mark, with a settings card to change them live, no rebuild and no reload.
## What it does
- Occupies the `sidebar.brand.mark`, `sidebar.brand.name`, and `conversation.hero.brand.mark` slots

with a custom icon and name, and swaps the browser favicon to match.
- **Settings card on the plugin
's detail page** (Plugins → dsh-plugin-brand-custom): edit the brand name, pick an icon image (PNG/J
PEG/WebP/GIF/SVG, up to 256KB, previewed in place), and save — the sidebar, hero, and favicon update

immediately. Reset restores the bundled defaults.
- Values persist in the profile's settings docume

nt, so every browser and every restart sees the same brand.
- Disables the official brand occupants

(`ui-brand-official`), which only register in `official` builds; single brand slots are exclusive.
-
Ships a bundled default icon from `src/client/assets/icon.png`, inlined as a base64 data URL by the
ed default icon from `src/client/assets/icon.png`, inlined as a base64 data URL by the tsdown build.
Requires dsh 0.1.7 or newer (the host serves the plugin's settings from its own Config schema there)
equires dsh 0.1.7 or newer (the host serves the plugin's settings from its own Config schema there).

Restart `dsh web`, then open **Plugins → dsh-plugin-brand-custom** (click the card title) to reach t

Remove with `dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-plugin-brand-custom`.
